Docs/Parallel environments

Parallel environments

Scale a supported evaluator while preserving seeds, complete episode accounting and native-scene constraints.

Parallelism is method-specific

The public PPO pixel trainer supports batched GPU physics for rollout collection. RLPD's documented pixel setting uses a single environment. Native-scene evaluation requires one CPU-physics environment per task/background pair. There is no universal environment count that every task, renderer or policy supports.

Read train/TRAIN_EVAL.md ↗ and your trainer's --help before increasing concurrency. More environments increase image buffers, renderer memory and bookkeeping requirements; a smaller successful smoke test is preferable to treating capacity as guaranteed.

Split independent scene combinations

python utils/scene_matrix.py plan --out output/scene90
python utils/scene_matrix.py preview --out output/scene90/preview --shard 0 --shards 3
python utils/scene_matrix.py preview --out output/scene90/preview --shard 1 --shards 3
python utils/scene_matrix.py preview --out output/scene90/preview --shard 2 --shards 3

These commands partition the placement-preview matrix; they do not evaluate a policy. Launch shards independently on allocated resources. utils/scene_matrix.py ↗ uses isolated child processes, preserves failure logs, and supports --resume for matching scene source hashes and seeds.

Never score only the surviving workers

The replay validator can distribute episodes with --jobs. A missing worker is not a failed policy episode and is not permission to report a rate over the survivors. An !! INCOMPLETE result withholds a valid release rate until the requested episodes are accounted for.

See data_gen/replay/README.md ↗ and Data & replay. For learned-policy evaluation, retain the requested seed list, completed attempts and infrastructure failures so a resumed job cannot silently change the denominator.

Keep the experimental unit unchanged

Do not reset an unfinished episode just because a neighboring vector environment completed. Preserve each task's horizon, model state, action queue and seed. Image-policy observations must retain the checkpoint's fixed camera configuration when batching.

Keep one result directory per method, checkpoint, task and scene identity. Aggregate after all expected records exist, not by averaging worker percentages with different sample counts. The evaluation guide and reproduction checklist describe the records to save.
